about: Where every column of data.js gets its values. verify/tables.js (the gate) fails on a column of data.js that is not here. Sources: bsdata (BSData wh40k-11e), wahapedia, gw (Games Workshop's documents), newrecruit (the owner's New Recruit PDFs), derived (computed by a verify/ script), hand (written by hand, with the note saying how it is checked), ai (AI-written; carries a fingerprint of the text it was written from).

name.note: the rule's name in the Core Rules

text.note: GW's Core Rules / Universal Rules Updates, or Wahapedia's core rules where marked; checked by verify/texts.js
